description.narrative: (West Bank and Gaza): .This activity develops life skills and work readiness training opportunities to promote job placement and community engagement for youth in the West Bank and Gaza. It also provides a venue for youth to access a variety of programming, which will ultimately provide an alternative means of empowerment for at-risk youth. Developing socio-economic competencies and exercising good citizenship will contribute to building the Palestinian human capital necessary for sustainable development. .Using FY22 funds, USAID's interventions will target vulnerable and marginalized youth with core programming that supports, protects, prepares, and engages adolescents in safe spaces (like Youth Development and Resource Centers, previously supported by USAID, and youth clubs). This includes psychosocial support, life and work readiness skills and referral to technical training and job opportunities. Efforts will include pathway programs in areas of media and ICT training, career guidance, psychosocial support, internships, civic educational programs, and sports. .Additionally, youth in grades 7 - 12 will benefit from supplemental learning opportunities to complement their school education in a non-formal setting. This support will improve their academic performance. Priorities of the non-formal education program will include English language, math, science and technology, life and work readiness and career guidance. .PYE will also target university students who will be provided with career guidance services along with life skills, internship, job fairs and entrepreneurship support through the career centers developed under earlier USAID youth projects. .This activity will contribute to the Higher and Basic Education earmarks. .
